title: Hey Mom…
subtitle: Recipes and stories from 28 years of feeding the people I love.
author: Missy
intro:
[DRAFT — Missy, edit this in your own words; I wrote a starting point from what you told me.]

For twenty-eight years, my job title was Mom, and my office was the kitchen. I stayed home and raised my kids on real food — the breakfasts before school, the dinners we fought to get everyone to the table for, the snacks that somehow vanished the moment they cooled. I packed the lunches, baked the treats for every classroom party and bake sale, and hosted the gatherings where the kitchen was always the most crowded room in the house. Food was how I showed up. It's how I said good morning, congratulations, I'm sorry, and I love you, often without saying a word.

This book is the collection of all of that. The recipes my kids grew up on and still call home asking for. The shortcuts I learned so good food didn't have to be hard. The holiday traditions, the crowd-feeding feasts, and the desserts that made it to more parties than I can count. Along the way I learned that a recipe is just a starting point — the magic is in making it your own, so it fits your family the way these fit mine. I hope they make their way into your kitchen, and your memories, too.
